title: Android users feature
scope: The users feature data path: Retrofit responses from UsersServiceApi, the paging mediator, mapping to Room entities, and the repository/use case exposing cached users to the UI. Ignore DI wiring, build scripts, tests, image loading and the Star Wars character screens.
hints: core/.../remote/api/UsersServiceApi.kt declares GET user and GET user/{userId}.
core/.../remote/mediator/UserRemoteMediator.kt fetches pages and writes users and remote keys through Room.
core/.../cache/AppDatabase.kt and the DAOs own the SQLite storage.
core/.../repo/UserRepositoryImpl.kt reads the cache and falls back to the detail endpoint.
features/users/... contains the use cases and ViewModels that expose the cached data to the UI.
rubric: The HTTP responses are inputs and Room is the storage. The mediator, mappers and repository are transformations; the ViewModel is a consumer of cached data, not a new source. The outer EntryPoints are the UI screens/actions that start list and detail retrieval; Retrofit methods, ViewModels, use cases and the mediator are internal participants, not triggers. The detail endpoint is a cache-miss branch of detail retrieval, not a separate pipeline. Penalize maps that invent queues, a remote database or one contract per Kotlin class.
